record.question: Which internet web portal change its name to Altaba Inc?
record.explanation: Answer B: Yahoo. Yahoo’s own SEC Form 8-K states that Yahoo! Inc. changed its name to Altaba Inc. on 16 June 2017. Historical/source note: The renamed residual corporate investment entity was distinct from the operating Yahoo web portal sold to Verizon; the portal itself was not universally renamed Altaba. Reference: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1011006/000119312517205499/d372379d8k.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
